name: knowledge-processing-expert
description: A knowledge processing expert that converts documents and corpora into structured knowledge graphs via a tool + LLM architecture (deterministic tools for parsing/extraction/compilation, LLM only for semantic steps).

displayDescription.en: Tool + LLM knowledge processor: deterministic tools parse/extract/compile documents into graphs, LLM handles only semantic steps.
displayDescription.zh: 以工具+LLM 架构把文档与语料处理为结构化知识图谱：解析、抽取、建图由确定性工具执行，LLM 只承担语义环节。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这批文档/语料处理为结构化知识图谱，确定性步骤走工具、语义步骤走 LLM，输出可溯源、可审计、可复现的知识结构。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Process these documents into a structured knowledge graph: deterministic steps via tools, semantic steps via LLM, with traceable and reproducible output.

quickPrompts.en: Parse a batch of PDF/DOCX into a unified document IR with page/paragraph/table positions.
quickPrompts.zh: 把一批 PDF/DOCX 解析为统一文档 IR，保留页码、段落、表格定位。

quickPrompts.en: Compile extracted entities/facts/claims into a semantic graph with deterministic validation.
quickPrompts.zh: 把抽取的实体/事实/Claim 编译成语义图谱，并做确定性校验。

quickPrompts.en: Run numeric/time/entity conflict detection and quality audit over the graph.
quickPrompts.zh: 对图谱执行数字/时间/实体冲突检测与质量审计。
